text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh? What are you writing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo was in an empty classroom all 
by herself, practicing calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh. It's what you'd call a 
challenge letter!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What beautiful handwriting. It's vivace 
and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Well, yeah~. Wanna write something 
too, Earth?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Me? Calligraphy? Giocoso! That sounds 
quite amusing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What should I try writing then? 
Plenty of musical scores come to mind, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just write down whatever comes to mind. 
Like, if you're thinking 'I'm gonna win!', 
write 'Earth Certain Victory'!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: As she pleases, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth closes her eyes and 
visualizes—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can hear it... This flickering sound 
is... the heartbeat of this star.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Space... In that eternal expanse of time, 
music is far too staccato. Fleeting, 
ephemeral...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I wrote down the word that 
flashed into my mind. —'Tamayura.'"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ta... Tamahi... How do you read this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Tamayura." It means a fleeting moment. It 
just popped into my head somehow.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I think it feels totally like you, 
Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie. Though it ended up leaning far 
more to one side than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once you write something down, you 
can't take it back—just like with musica, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a brand new door has opened 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Sounds of Earth's running grew 
notably sharper.
